unit: one paired question; exploratory, no significance claim
factual_correctness: Adjudicate each submitted claim against opened originals: supported in stated scope, contradicted, or not verifiable. Report numerator and denominator; uncertainty is not an error. Audit conclusion overreach separately.
source_quality: Count inspected primary/secondary sources and independent evidence lineages. Judge methods disclosure, relevant comparator, and resource matching. Do not equate source count with quality.

criteria: Explains material differences of task/comparator/compute rather than treating all numbers as comparable
Preserves unresolved disagreement and specifies evidence needed to resolve it
Identifies direct positive comparison relevant to technical research
Distinguishes autonomy/tool access from multi-agent architecture

human_intervention: User instructions needed after initial goal; keep engineering setup and automated verification separate.
cost: Record measured billable USD only if exposed. Never replace missing token/subscription cost with zero. Record paid API calls and tool usage separately. Quality per dollar is unavailable without cost data.
elapsed_time: Per-arm start to final artifact, including retrieval and reasoning, excluding prototype engineering and posthoc evaluation.
limits: One question is not a benchmark
Reasoning tokens and exact sampling parameters unavailable
Same inherited model family, no paid model calls
A host agent can bypass an advisory ledger; enforce at the trusted tool gateway in production
